definitions.short: properly, the flank ; but used only figuratively, the rear or recess
definitions.full: H3411. yerekah [ יַרְכָה , or יְרֵכָה Ol § 167. g ] flank, side , dual extreme parts, recesses ; — suffix יַרְכָֿתוֺ Gen 49:13 ; dual יַרְכָתַיִם Exod 26:27 ; 36:32 + Ezek 46:19 Qr (Kt ירכתם ); יַרְכָתָ֑יִם Exod 26:23 ; 36:28 ; construct יַרְכְּתֵי Judg 19:1 20 t. + 1Kin 6:16 Qr (Kt ירכותי ); — 1 side , i.e. further side of Zebulun, poetic for more distant border of his territory Gen 49:13 . 2 elsewhere always dual the two things , i.e. figurative angle, recess, extreme parts: as recesses of Mt. Ephraim Judg 19:1 , 18 ; of Lebanon 2Kin 19:23 = Isa 37:24 ; of recesses or innermost part of a cave 1Sam 24:4 ; a house Amos 6:10 ; Psa 128:3 ; the pit ( בּוֺר ) Isa 14:15 (|| שְׁאוֺל ), Ezek 32:23 ; a ship Jonah 1:5 ; צָפוֺן יַרְכְּתֵי remote parts of the north Isa 14:13 ; Ezek 38:6 , 15 ; 39:2 ; Psa 48:3 (but here Lag proposes ׳יר רצון ); אָ֑רֶץ יַרְכְּתֵי remote parts of earth Jer 6:22 ; 25:32 ; 31:8 ; 50:41 ; of a long building, extreme or hinder part , so of tabernacle Exod 26:22-23 , 27 ; 36:27-28 , 32 (all P); of temple 1Kin 6:16 ; of Ezekiel's temple Ezek 46:19 .
